subTitle: 我的博客
indexStyle:
<style>
  /* page background image (kept behind content) */
  html::before{content:'';position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:-1;background-image:url('/images/bg.webp');background-size:cover;background-position:center;filter:brightness(0.95);}

  /* make main content areas translucent so the background shows through, keep text readable */
  .container, .main, .content, .post-list, .posts, .post-card, .card, .post, .article, .page-main {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.78) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(120%) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(6px) saturate(120%) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) !important;
  }

  /* headers/sidebars slightly more opaque for contrast */
  header, .site-header, .nav, .sidebar, footer, .site-footer {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88) !important;
  }

  /* dark mode support: use translucent dark backgrounds */
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
    .container, .main, .content, .post-list, .posts, .post-card, .card, .post, .article, .page-main {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5) !important;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.45) !important;
    }
    header, .site-header, .nav, .sidebar, footer, .site-footer {
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6) !important;
    }
  }

  /* Make sure the fixed background stays behind everything */
  html::before{pointer-events:none;}
</style>
